description: Change history of ONE record (person, organisation, lead, task …): who created, changed, exported or read it, when, and which field went from which value to which. Required: entity (table, e.g. contacts, accounts, leads), entity_id. Optional: include_reads (default true: read accesses to personal data are logged too), limit (default 100). Fields hidden from your role are left out; names of the people who acted are resolved.

entity.description: Table of the record, e.g. contacts, accounts, leads

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return

name: list_record_history
